subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should stranded `message_tool_only` finals recover only behind `messages.strandedReplyRecovery`, recover by default through the successor approach, or remain diagnostics-only?
rationale: The current documented contract says no message-tool call means no source reply, while this PR adds a config surface and replays private final text into a bounded retry prompt, so automation cannot safely choose the product/privacy policy.

options.title: Keep Opt-In Recovery After Proof
options.body: Approve this PR's default-off recovery shape only after redacted real external chat proof shows one bounded retry and no duplicate delivery.

options.title: Prefer Default Recovery
options.body: Use a refreshed successor approach if maintainers want existing `message_tool_only` users protected without requiring a new config flag.

options.title: Stay Diagnostics-Only
options.body: Reject runtime recovery and keep warning/docs behavior if preserving the strict no-tool-call privacy contract matters more than automatic recovery.

recommendation.title: Keep Opt-In Recovery After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve this PR's default-off recovery shape only after redacted real external chat proof shows one bounded retry and no duplicate delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current diagnostics-only behavior and is the clearest history-backed owner for the recovery policy choice.
